name: revyl
description: Run mobile changes on Revyl cloud devices and verify them with screenshots and semantic validation through the Revyl CLI.

interface.longDescription: Use the Revyl CLI to run mobile apps, inspect screenshots, validate behavior, and verify CI-uploaded pull request builds. Adds Revyl's hosted workspace tools for finding builds and driving devices, and a session-start check of CLI sign-in, project configuration, and GitHub pull-request builds. Requires shell access and Revyl sign-in; the hosted tools sign in once with OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Run this app on a Revyl device and verify my change.
Verify this pull request using its CI-uploaded Revyl build.
